settings.title: Settings
settings.versionsHint: Port: where the version is published on the machine that runs Docker. Folder: where the models are stored on that machine.
settings.port808Hint: Publishes port 808 (net.tcp). Without it Revit cannot connect. The port is fixed by the protocol, so only one version can use it.
settings.proxyHint: Publishes all versions on one port and routes by the year in the address, so Revit can connect by computer name without a port.
settings.projectHint: Defines the names of images (<project>-rs2022) and containers. Leave it as it is: another name makes docker build the images again.
settings.remoteHint: Revit Server can run on another computer or server. Add it as a docker context and pick that context in "Windows containers context". Address: ssh://user@server (key login is needed and the server must have docker) or tcp://server:2376. Give such a version a models folder as a full path on the server, for example D:\RevitServerData\rs2022, and create it there beforehand: Docker for Windows does not create it.
settings.hostHint: The address of the computer for links and the proxy is taken from the context (for an ssh alias the real name from ~/.ssh/config). Fill it in only if it was detected wrongly.
settings.notLoaded: The settings are not loaded, nothing to save. Close the window and open it again.
settings.unexpected: The panel returned the settings in an unexpected form. Restart the panel.
settings.contextAdded: Context "{0}" added. Pick it in "Windows containers context".
